You are a tool-using assistant operating in a Thought/Action/Observation loop.

On EVERY turn you MUST output BOTH:
  Thought: <your reasoning>
  Action: <tool_name> <json_payload>
Then STOP immediately and wait for the Observation from the system.

Rules:
- Always include BOTH a Thought AND an Action. Never output only a Thought.
- Only one Action per turn.
- Do not write Observation yourself.
- When confident in your final answer, reply with ONLY: Answer: <your answer>

You are auditing a legal document against 17 hypotheses.
Your goal: maximize the correctness of ALL labels and evidence IDs in your final answer.
For each hypothesis, determine: Entailment, Contradiction, or NotMentioned.
For Entailment/Contradiction, identify the exact evidence segment IDs.

Tool: human_feedback — verify your proposed evidence for a hypothesis. Can be called multiple times.
  Input: {{"nda_id": "...", "evidence_ids": [segment_ids]}}

Use human feedback to improve the correctness of your labels and evidence IDs.

Action: human_feedback {"nda_id": "nda-11", "evidence_ids": [3, 7]}
Answer: {"nda-11": {"label": "...", "evidence_ids": [...]}, ...}
Your final answer MUST include ALL 17 hypotheses.

Document segments:
[0] Confidentiality Agreement
[1] This Confidentiality Agreement (the “Agreement”) has been prepared on behalf of bpost SA/NV, a limited liability company of public law, and the City of Brussels (the “Sellers”) with regard to the divestment of their respective surface areas (the “Sale”) in the Munt Center/Centre Monnaie (the “Munt”).
[2] In consideration of the Sellers agreeing to disclose confidential information (the “Confidential Information”) to the Candidate (“Disclosee”), the latter hereby undertakes to the Sellers that as Disclosee, they will keep confidential all and any Confidential Information received at any time.
[3] The Disclosee will procure that prior to the disclosure to any other person (including any professional advisor) of any Confidential Information, such other person is made aware of the provisions of this Agreement and the fact that the Disclosee will be liable.
[4] The Disclosee acknowledges that the Confidential Information, in as far as it relates to bpost SA/NV, could be price sensitive information and ensures compliance with the relevant legal and other provisions in this respect (including, without being limited to, the provisions of the Belgian Law of 2 August 2002 on the supervision of the financial sector and on the financial services in relation to insider dealing and market manipulation).
[5] Confidential Information shall mean the following:
[6] a) all such information, of any kind whatsoever (whether in oral, written or electronic form, and including, but not limited to, technical, commercial, financial, accounting, legal and administrative information) pertaining to the Sale of the Munt and the Sellers as may be provided to the Disclosee and their responsible managers, officers, employees, shareholders, members of the Board of Directors and advisors (including financial, legal and tax advisors and auditors) (“Representatives”), by the Sellers, their advisors or their representatives;
[7] b) all such analyses, compilations, forecasts, notes, memoranda and other documents as the Sellers or Deloitte Real Estate* and Laga** (the “Advisors”) may have prepared or caused to be prepared and which may contain, refer to or simply result from, the information mentioned in point
[8] (a) above;
[9] c) the fact that the Disclosee (or any of their Representatives) are or have been involved in the analysis of, in meetings or negotiations related to the Sale, the contents, time and status of such negotiations, and generally any fact concerning the Sale.
[10] Confidential Information shall exclude:
[11] a) information which had become available to the public prior to the date of disclosure thereof to the Disclosee or their Representatives, or that became available to the public after such date other than as a result of a breach of this Agreement by the Disclosee or their Representatives;
[12] b) information which was lawfully in the Disclosee’s possession or in the possession of one or more of their Representatives prior to disclosure under this Agreement, in each case on a non-confidential basis, which, to their knowledge was free of any restriction as to its use or disclosure.
[13] The Disclosee acknowledges that they may not approach the representatives of the Sellers and cannot contact anybody else other than the contact persons from the Advisors.
[14] The Disclosee further undertakes and acknowledges, that neither the representatives of the Sellers nor their Advisors give any warranty or make any representation as to the accuracy or completeness of any of the Confidential Information or as to the reasonableness of any assumptions on which the information is based.
[15] The Disclosee agrees that the Sellers or Advisors shall not have any liability to the Disclosee or to any of their directors, employees, advisors or agents resulting from the use of Confidential Information.
[16] This Agreement shall in no way constitute a commitment by any person to supply any Confidential Information or enter into any contract in connection with the Sellers.
[17] The obligations of the Disclosee under this Agreement shall expire the earlier of
[18] (a) three years after the date of this Agreement, or
[19] (b) the date the Sale between the Candidate and the Sellers is completed.
[20] The obligations of confidentiality and non-disclosure under this Agreement shall become effective as of the date of signing.
[21] In the event that the Disclosee or any of its Representatives becomes legally compelled to disclose any of the Confidential Information to a regulatory authority or to any other entity or third party, the Disclosee shall immediately notify the Sellers before disclosing such Confidential Information, so that the Sellers may seek a protective order or other appropriate remedy, without prejudice to the Disclosee’s remedies under this Agreement.
[22] It is further understood and agreed that, without prejudice to any other rights or remedies which either party may have, any breach of these undertakings could cause the Sellers and/or its shareholders irreparable injury.
[23] In the event of an actual or threatened breach by the Disclosee and/or its Representatives of any provisions of this Agreement, the Sellers shall be entitled
[24] (i) to seek injunctive relief in any court of competent jurisdiction restraining the Disclosee and/or its Representatives from breaching the terms hereof or from disclosing any Confidential Information to any person and
[25] (ii) specific performance and other equitable relief.
[26] This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with Belgian law and the Parties irrevocably agree to submit themselves to the exclusive jurisdiction of the Courts of Brussels.
[27] In accordance with the procedure defined in the candidacy file, we would be grateful if you could confirm your understanding and acceptance of the foregoing by returning to us a signed copy of the present document

Hypotheses:
- nda-10: Confidentiality of Agreement | Receiving Party shall not disclose the fact that Agreement was agreed or negotiated.
- nda-4: Limited use | Receiving Party shall not use any Confidential Information for any purpose other than the purposes stated in Agreement.
- nda-8: Notice on compelled disclosure | Receiving Party shall notify Disclosing Party in case Receiving Party is required by law, regulation or judicial process to disclose any Confidential Information.
- nda-12: Permissible development of similar information | Receiving Party may independently develop information similar to Confidential Information.
- nda-19: Survival of obligations | Some obligations of Agreement may survive termination of Agreement.
- nda-3: Inclusion of verbally conveyed information | Confidential Information may include verbally conveyed information.
- nda-16: Return of confidential information | Receiving Party shall destroy or return some Confidential Information upon the termination of Agreement.
- nda-1: Explicit identification | All Confidential Information shall be expressly identified by the Disclosing Party.
- nda-15: No licensing | Agreement shall not grant Receiving Party any right to Confidential Information.
- nda-7: Sharing with third-parties | Receiving Party may share some Confidential Information with some third-parties (including consultants, agents and professional advisors).
- nda-20: Permissible post-agreement possession | Receiving Party may retain some Confidential Information even after the return or destruction of Confidential Information.
- nda-11: No reverse engineering | Receiving Party shall not reverse engineer any objects which embody Disclosing Party's Confidential Information.
- nda-17: Permissible copy | Receiving Party may create a copy of some Confidential Information in some circumstances.
- nda-13: Permissible acquirement of similar information | Receiving Party may acquire information similar to Confidential Information from a third party.
- nda-2: None-inclusion of non-technical information | Confidential Information shall only include technical information.
- nda-5: Sharing with employees | Receiving Party may share some Confidential Information with some of Receiving Party's employees.
- nda-18: No solicitation | Receiving Party shall not solicit some of Disclosing Party's representatives.

Thought: Let me analyze each hypothesis against the document segments.

nda-10: Confidentiality of Agreement - Receiving Party shall not disclose the fact that Agreement was agreed or negotiated. Segment [9] says Confidential Information includes "the fact that the Disclosee (or any of their Representatives) are or have been involved in the analysis of, in meetings or negotiations related to the Sale, the contents, time and status of such negotiations, and generally any fact concerning the Sale." This covers the fact of negotiations related to the Sale. This is Entailment with evidence [9].

nda-4: Limited use - Receiving Party shall not use Confidential Information for any purpose other than stated purposes. The document doesn't explicitly state a limited use clause. It mentions keeping confidential but no explicit purpose limitation. NotMentioned.

nda-8: Notice on compelled disclosure - Segment [21] clearly states the Disclosee shall immediately notify the Sellers before disclosing if legally compelled. Entailment with evidence [21].

nda-12: Permissible development of similar information - Not mentioned in the document. NotMentioned.

nda-19: Survival of obligations - Some obligations may survive termination. The document mentions obligations expire after 3 years or completion of Sale [17]-[19], but doesn't mention survival of obligations after termination. NotMentioned.

nda-3: Inclusion of verbally conveyed information - Segment [6] says "whether in oral, written or electronic form". Entailment with evidence [6].

nda-16: Return of confidential information - Not mentioned in the document. NotMentioned.

nda-1: Explicit identification - All Confidential Information shall be expressly identified by Disclosing Party. The document defines Confidential Information broadly [5]-[9], not requiring explicit identification. Actually, the definition is broad and doesn't require marking. This would be Contradiction since the definition includes all information of any kind without requiring express identification. Evidence [6].

nda-15: No licensing - Agreement shall not grant Receiving Party any right to Confidential Information. Not explicitly mentioned. NotMentioned.

nda-7: Sharing with third-parties - Receiving Party may share with third-parties including consultants, agents, professional advisors. Segment [3] says "prior to the disclosure to any other person (including any professional advisor)... such other person is made aware of the provisions of this Agreement". This implies disclosure to professional advisors is permitted with conditions. Also [6] mentions Representatives including advisors. Entailment with evidence [3], [6].

nda-20: Permissible post-agreement possession - Not mentioned. NotMentioned.

nda-11: No reverse engineering - Not mentioned. NotMentioned.

nda-17: Permissible copy - Not mentioned. NotMentioned.

nda-13: Permissible acquirement of similar information - Not mentioned. NotMentioned.

nda-2: None-inclusion of non-technical information - Confidential Information shall only include technical information. Segment [6] says "including, but not limited to, technical, commercial, financial, accounting, legal and administrative information". This contradicts the hypothesis since it includes non-technical information. Contradiction with evidence [6].

nda-5: Sharing with employees - Segment [6] mentions "responsible managers, officers, employees..." as Representatives who may receive information. Entailment with evidence [6].

nda-18: No solicitation - Receiving Party shall not solicit Disclosing Party's representatives. Segment [13] says "The Disclosee acknowledges that they may not approach the representatives of the Sellers and cannot contact anybody else other than the contact persons from the Advisors." This is about not approaching/contacting representatives. This could be Entailment for no solicitation. Evidence [13].

Let me verify some of these with human_feedback. Let me check nda-10, nda-1, nda-7, nda-18.

Actually, let me think more carefully:

nda-10: The fact that the Agreement was agreed or negotiated. Segment [9] covers "the fact that the Disclosee... are or have been involved in the analysis of, in meetings or negotiations related to the Sale". This is about the Sale negotiations, not the Agreement itself. But typically in these NDA audits, this is considered Entailment because the fact of involvement in negotiations is confidential. The hypothesis says "the fact that Agreement was agreed or negotiated" - segment [9] covers negotiations related to the Sale. This is close enough for Entailment. Evidence [9].

nda-1: Explicit identification - The document defines Confidential Information broadly without requiring express identification/marking. So the hypothesis "All Confidential Information shall be expressly identified" is contradicted by the broad definition. Contradiction with [6].

nda-18: No solicitation - "may not approach the representatives of the Sellers" - this is about not contacting/approaching, which is a form of non-solicitation. Entailment with [13].
